claim_text: The Hill reported on 16 August 2026 that Trump said in a Truth Social post that he had told Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to substantially reduce the joint military exercises with South Korea.
quote: President Trump said Sunday he told Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to “substantially reduce” the joint military exercises with South Korea.
confidence_justification: Summary-only item, but it quotes the operative phrase from the president's post directly.
